name: CabinetCraft
job.intro: Umsebenzi uyigumbi elinemigqa yamakhabethe odongeni lwalo. Khetha iyunithi nokuthi amakhabethe akhiwa kanjani, nikeza usayizi wegumbi, bese uhlela imigqa ku-Ukubuka Ukuhlelwa.
job.name: Igama lomsebenzi
job.room.note: Ukuphakama kwegumbi. Ukwakheka kwalo, izindonga, izinyango namafasitela kusethelwa ku-Ukubuka Igumbi.
job.kept: Umsebenzi ugcinwa kulesi siphequluli njengoba usebenza. Londoloza ifayela lomsebenzi ukuze ugcine kwenye indawo.
run.none: Lo msebenzi awukabi nomugqa. Engeza omunye ngenkinobho ethi Umugqa.
run.title: Umugqa wokuqala womshini
run.name: Igama
run.autofill: Gcwalisa okusele okuncane (kuya ku-75 mm noma 3 in) ngesigcwalisi
row.base: Umugqa wesisekelo: amakhabethe asezansi, amadilowa namakhabethe ade
row.over: Idlula udonga ngo-{n} {unit}: susa ikhabethe noma lenze libe lincane.
add.fill.title: Engeza isigcwalisi sokusele, uma singu-75 mm (3 in) noma ngaphansi
mat.intro: Khetha ibhodi, ingemuva, izinhlangothi zangaphambili nobhendo lomphetho. Amagama nobukhulu kungena ohlwini lokusika; usayizi weshidi ngalinye ungowokuhlelwa.
mat.rules.note: Ukusebenza okuvamile kwesitolo ezinombolweni ongazishintsha. Zihlole nge-hardware yakho ngaphambi kokusika.
mat.custom.note: Engeza ibhodi esilithenga esitolo sakho. Ubukhulu nosayizi weshidi: {unit}. Igama lalo lihlala njengobaulibhala.
mat.custom.name: Igama
checks.none: Akukho okufanele kulungiswe: akukho khabethe noma mugqa onenkinga ezihlolwa yizihlolo.

cost.allplaceholder: Zonke izinga lapha ngamabhodi okuphatha: izinombolo ezingelona uhlu lwentengo. Faka izinga lesitolo sakho ngaphambi kokunikeza noma yini.
cost.someplaceholder: {n} kwemigqa engu: {of} isasebenzisa izinga lokuphatha (limakwe *). Faka elesitolo sakho kuyo.
cost.area: Amashidi alinganiselwe ngendawo yezingxenye. Hlela umsebenzi kuMbukwano Wokuthumela ukuze uthole inani eliqinile.
cost.csvnote: {n} kwezinga {of} amabhodi okuphatha aze afakwe ezesitolo.
draw.note: Imidwebo ivela kumakhabethe afanayo nohlu lokusika, ngakho ayikwazi ukungavumelani nawo. Ayilingani ekhasini: funda izilinganiso.
exp.nonest: Hlela umsebenzi ukuze uthole inani lamashidi, i-oda lokusika kumalebula, amashidi njenge-DXF kanye ne-G-code.
exp.gcode.note: Uhlelo olulodwa ngeshidi ngalinye lempahla ngayinye, lwenziwe endleleni yamashidi ahleliwe ye-PartCraft: ukusika kwesondo ezungeze zonke izingxenye ngethuluzi oliliqambayo. Alisebenzi kunoma yimuphi umshini.
exp.verify: Hlola ifayela ngalinye emshinini wakho nangempahla yakho ngaphambi kokuliqalisa. Usayizi awuxhunyiwe kunoma yimuphi umenzi we-hardware: hlola ngaphambi kokusika.

room.intro: Umbobo wegumbi (isikwele, i-L, i-U noma umbobo ukhululekile onamakona ayisikwele), iminyango namawindi alo, nanoma yisiqhingi noma isiqhingi esixhumene. Amakhabethe ahleliswa ngasezindongeni kumbono Wokuhlela futhi ahlonipha lokho okusethwe lapha.
room.l.note: I-L iyisikwele esinesikhala esisikwe ekhoneni elilodwa. Izindonga ziba yi-Udonga 1, i-Udonga 2 njalo njalo, ngokuphambene nesikhathi sewashi.
room.u.note: I-U iyisikwele esinesikhala esisikwe emaphakathi nohlangothi olulodwa.
room.free.note: Ikhoni eyodwa ngomugqa ngamunye njenge x, y, iyunithi {unit}, ngokulandelana ezungeze igumbi. Yonke imiphetho kumele ihambe ngokuya ku-x noma ku-y; imiphetho akufanele idlule kwenye.
room.free.bad: Lo mbobo awukwazi ukusetshenziswa: yonke imiphetho kumele ihambe ngokuya ku-x noma ku-y, imiphetho akufanele idlule kwenye, futhi kudingeka okungenani amakhoni amane.
room.pick.label: Icwebe lokuchofoza amakhoni egumbi kuwo
room.pick.note: Chofoza amakhoni ngokulandelana ezungeze igumbi. Ikhoni ngalinye liyashintsha lapho kuthi: {grid}, futhi libe nomugqa oqondile kusukela kowangaphambi kwalo. Bese Vala umbobo.
room.reflex: iqala ekhoneni langaphakathi (akukho sindonga ngemuva kokuqala kwalo)
open.gap.title: Ibeka isikhala emgqeni wohlelo lwansi lapho kukhona lesi sivulo, ukuze amakhabethe alandelayo ahambe.
open.note: Umnyango ugcinwa uvulekile phambili (futhi ukuvuleka kwawo kuyahlolwa); iwindi lingaba nekhabethe lansi ngaphansi kwalo, kodwa akukho lutho phambi kwengilazi. Ukuhlola kumaka okungafanele. Izindawo zilinganiswa kusukela ekhoneni lokuqala lesindonga, njengalokhu kwemigqa.
island.note: Amakhabethe esiqhingi ami ohlangothini olulodwa lomugqa wangemuva wawo (olwesobunxele lapho uhamba ngawo), nomugqa wesibili ongabhekana nolunye uhlangothi ungakhethwa. Uhlangothi olumelene nesindonga lwenza kube yisiqhingi esixhumene: ngeke kube nephaneli yokugcina lapho, akukho ukuphuphuma. Ukuhlola kumaka umsele omncane kunama-900 mm (36 in), inani elijwayelekile, hhayi umthetho.
island.layout.note: Isiqhingi {id}: indawo nobukhulu baso kusethwe kumbono Wegumbi. Amakhabethe aso ahleliswa lapha njengomugqa.
island.back.empty: Akukho mugqa wesibili. Engeza amakhabethe lapha ukuze kubekwe umugqa ongemuva kwawo, ubhekene nenye indlela.
cost.import.note: Landa ishidi lezinga, gcwalisa amanani akho (ichashazi lesikhethi, hhayi ikhoma), bese uyalingisa futhi; noma ngenisa i-CSV (indlela,inani) noma i-JSON yakho. Izinga oliphe kuphela ziyashintshwa; okunye kusalele njengezibambeli. Izinga logcinwa kanye nomsebenzi.
v3d.title: Ukubonakala kwe-3D ku-PartCraft viewport
v3d.note: Ibeka amakhabethe njengezinto ku-viewport: into ngayinye yephaneli, umnyango, ingaphambili yedrowa, isigcwalisi, iphaneli yokugcina nomphezulu wekhawunta, zinemibala ngokukhetha kwempahla yakho. Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuphenduka; ukubeka futhi kuyabuyisela. Zikhona ukuze zibukwe: azisiyo ingxenye yesisekelo sengxenye, ngakho azengezi ubunzima noma i-STL.
v3d.unavailable: Le PartCraft ayikwazi ukubeka izinto ku-viewport (idinga i-add-on API 1.1).
v3d.none: Akukho lutho kulo msebenzi okusesikrinini sokubuka.
v3d.label: CabinetCraft: beka amakhabethe

prob.corner.small: Ikhabethe {no}: ikhabethe lekhoni lineububanzi {w} nokujula {d}, ngakho iminyango yezingalo ingaba mincane kakhulu. Kudingeka ububanzi bungenani {min}.

room.seg.note: Bhala izindonga ngomugqa ngamunye, uqale ekhoneni lokuqala: “length angle” ngodonga oluqondile (i-angle iyindlela ngamadigri, 0 = empumalanga, 90 = enyakatho), noma “arc radius sweep heading” ngodonga oluyi-arc (sweep + ikhomba kude negumbi, - ngene kulo; heading iyindlela ukusuka lapho iqala kuya lapho iphela). Umbobo uvala wena ngokwawo.
room.seg.bad: Lezi zindonga azikwazi ukwenza igumbi: umugqa ngamunye udinga izinombolo ezimbili, i-arc idinga i-radius kanye ne-sweep phakathi kuka 0.5 no 179 amadigri, nombobo akufanele uzigqume.
room.arcwall.note: Yenza esinye sezindonga zombobo ukhululekile sibe yi-arc: khetha udonga kanye ne-sweep ngamadigri (+ igoqa kude negumbi, isigodi; - igoqa ngena kulo).
room.arc.bad: Lawa mapoyinti amathathu akha igobe phakathi kuka-0.5 no-170 amadigri.
room.pick.any: Noma iyiphi i-engeli (hhayi amakhona angu-90 kuphela)
room.pick.arc: Izindonga ezigobile: chofoza iphoyinti egobeni, bese uchofoza lapho liphela
room.pick.arc.mid: Chofoza iphoyinti egobeni phakathi kwekhona lokugcina nalapho liphela.
prob.corner.angle.angle: {no} ({form}) ifanele ikhona elilungile kuphela, futhi leli khona linamadigri {inside} ngaphakathi. Sebenzisa ikhabethe lekhona elinephaneli ephambili ephendulwe (lenziwa ngengeli eliqondile) noma ikhabethe elijwayelekile elinephaneli yokuvala.
prob.corner.angle.arc: {no} ({form}) isekhoneni eduze kodonga oluwugobe: amakhabethe ekhona adinga izindonga ezimbili ezigqamile. Ihlelwe njengekhabethe elijwayelekile; sebenzisa amakhabethe odonga oluwugobe ngesigodlo.
prob.corner.angle.size: {no} ({form}) imkhulu kakhulu ekhoneni lekhabethe elinephaneli ephambili ephendulwe ({inside} amadigri ngaphakathi): izingalo zayo azishiyi indawo yephaneli ephambili. Yenze incane ngobubanzi noma ngokujula.
prob.corner.sharp: Ikhona phakathi kwemigqa {a} nemigqa {b} linamadigri {inside} ngaphakathi kuphela: akukho fomu esitokweni elifanelayo (isiphetho sekhabethe besizoma phambi kodonga olulandelayo). Hlukanisa ikhona ngekhabethe oyidizayini yakho, noma shintsha i-engeli yodonga.

prob.corner.diag: {no} yikhabethe lekhona elinephaneli ephambili ephendulwe, esikwe ngekhona elinamadigri {inside} ngaphakathi; ibhodi yalo ephambili inde {front}.
prob.corner.drillsize: Amakhabethe ekhona {list} abhobozwa lapho uhlelo luchaza khona izimbobo; ubukhulu bezinhlobo {kinds} buvela ezingxenyeni zakho futhi busengamhlophe: bhala ku-Export > Drilling sizes.

prob.arc.wedge: Umugqa {run} ({row}): amagebe esigaxa {n} phakathi kwamakhabethe, abanzi kakhulu {w} ephaneli ephambili: wavale ngezigcwalisi zesigaxa noma khetha amakhabethe amancane.

note.corner.wedge: Ivala isiphetho somugqa ekhoneni lenye i-engeli; ikhona elingasebenzi ngemuva kwayo yingunxantathu yesikwele enemacala {leg1} nelika {leg2}.

cost.first.title: Bhala amazinga ensitolo yakho
cost.first.body: Yonke into lapha iyizinga lesikhashana, hhayi uhlu lwentengo lomuntu. Bhala amazinga ensitolo yakho ngaphansi kwe-Rates, noma landa ishidi lamazinga, uligcwalise, bese uliletha. Uze wenze lokho, isilinganiso siyisibonelo.
cost.quote.final: ISIKHOLA SOKUGCINA: yonke izinga elisetshenziswayo lelensitolo yakho
cost.lint.open: Izigaba {n} zisasebenzisa amazinga esikhashana, ngakho lokhu akukwazi ukubizwa ngokuthi isikhola sokugcina:
cost.lint.none: Yonke izinga umsebenzi osebenzisayo ngelensitolo yakho.
cost.lint.note: Izinga libalwa njengelakho uma ulibhalile noma ulilethile, noma linganalo izinga lesikhashana.
hw.title: Ubukhulu bezimbobo obuzibhalayo
hw.note: Ubukhulu obuchazwa izingxenye zakho (amaphini okhuni noma amakhamu, i-shaft nepivoti ye-lazy susan). Zihlala zingenalutho uze uzibhale; uhlu lwezimbobo lamakhona lazo lube selukhona. Izikhundla zivela emithethweni ye-32 mm, hhayi ubukhulu obenziwe.
dry.title: Ukuhamba okomile (kuhlola amafayela, akuqalisi lutho)
dry.honest: Akukho ukusebenza kwemshini okwenzekile. Lokhu kufunda izinhlelo nohlu lwezimbobo njengesimulator esincane bese kudwebela lokho okubonayo; ukusebenza kokuqala emshinini nokubuka komenzi kungokwakho.
dry.rapid: Isivinini semshini sakho esisheshayo (mm ngomzuzu), sesilinganiso sesikhathi
dry.nofiles: Akukho G-code okwamanje: hlanganisa amashidi futhi wenze i-G-code kuqala. Uhlu lwezimbobo luyahlolwa noma kunjalo.

run.c.tool: Ithuluzi kwi-spindle yithuluzi uhlelo olicela (ububanzi, ubude).
run.c.spindle: Isivinini se-spindle ohlelweni silungile lalo thuluzi nalo mpahla.
run.c.origin: Imvelaphi isethwe lapho uhlelo lulindele khona (ikhona lesobunxele langaphambili, phezulu kweshidi).
run.c.spoil: Ibhodi lenkunkuma linganyakazi futhi ishidi ngeke lisikeke lingene kulokho okubalulekile.

run.c.air: Uhlelo lwenziwa emoyeni, kancane ngaphezu kweshidi, ngaphambi kokusika.
run.c.estop: Umuntu umi empinini yokuyeka ukusebenza ukuhamba okokuqala.
run.f.cut: Ukusika kokuqala kubukwe kusukela kuqala kuze kuphele.
run.f.sheet: Ishidi lonke lahlolwa ukuthola izingxenye ezinyakazile.
run.f.holes: Izimbobo zahlolwa nohlu lwezimbobo (uma zibhobozwe kule mshini).
rev.title: Ishidi lokubuyekeza lomenzi
rev.note: Zonke izilinganiso nemithetho amakhabethe ekhona, amadonga aphendulwe namagobe nokubhoboza akusebenzisile. Izilinganiso ngokwejwayelekile nangejometri, hhayi izingxenye zomenzi othile; akukho ukusebenza kwemshini noma ukubuyekezwa komenzi okwenzekile. Ngena "umenzi uqinisekisa" noma ubhale ukulungisa.
rev.src.rule: umthetho wesistimu ye-32 mm (ungashintshwa phansi kwe-Materials)
rev.shelf.how: Amaphini ezinhlangothini zokuphela; isiphetho sekhona sakho ngasinye sihlala phezu komakhelwane wawo (umenzi aqinisekise)
rev.drill.pins: Imigqa yamaphini: kusuka emphethweni / ukuhamba / isimbobo sokuqala
rev.drill.cup: Inkomishi yesibambi: ububanzi, umphetho kusuka emphethweni wocango
rev.wedge.legs: Ikhona elingasebenzi ngemuva kwayo (imilenze yonxantathu oqondile)
rev.void: Izikhala ezibanzi kakhulu phakathi kwamakhabethe, odongeni
rev.wedgefront: Igebe lesigaxa elibanzi kakhulu phakathi kwamakhabethe, ephaneli ephambili
rev.none: Lo msebenzi awunawo amakhabethe ekhona, amakhona ahlehliwe namadonga agobile.
hostroom.none: Akutholakali gumbi. Khetha elilodwa kuqala (bona inothi elingenhla).
hostroom.bad: Lesi sakhiwo asikwazi ukusetshenziswa njengegumbi (sidinga izindawo ezintathu noma ngaphezulu nendawo).
hostroom.done: Igumbi "{name}" lithathwe kumodeli: izindonga {walls}, izivulo {placed} zibekiwe, {skipped} zishiyiwe (ziphambili ngaphezu kwe-600 mm kodonga).
exp.gcode.none: G-code: lolu hlelo alunakho ukuthumela kwe-CAM. Uthola uhlu lokusika, amashidi ahlelwe njenge-DXF, uhlu lokubhoboza nezinhlamvu (CSV, DXF, HTML); i-DXF ivula ku-Manufacture ye-PartCraft ukuze uthole i-G-code.
prob.host.nogcode: Lolu hlelo alunakho ukuthumela kwe-CAM, ngakho akukho i-G-code lapha: sebenzisa uhlu lokusika, amashidi ahlelwe njenge-DXF, uhlu lokubhoboza nezinhlamvu, noma vula i-DXF ku-Manufacture ye-PartCraft.
prob.host.snapshot: Amakhabethe emodeli, esakhiwo noma emdwebweni akhiwa emsebenzini lapho ucindezela inkinobho. Ukushintsha umsebenzi ngemva kwalokho akuwuhambisi uze ubeke noma udwebe futhi, nokuhlela kwawo lapho akushintshi umsebenzi.
bim.room.title: Sebenzisa igumbi emodelini
bim.room.note: Ibala amagumbi edonga lemodeli evulekile, avele ahlangane namadonga akhethwe kuqala. Igumbi libe yigumbi lomsebenzi, nezivulo zalo zibe yizivulo zomsebenzi; amakhabethe bese ebekwa kuleso sitezi.
bim.nolevel: Imodeli ayinalo izinga lokubeka amakhabethe kulo.
bim.place.title: Amakhabethe emodelini
bim.place.note: Yenza ikhabethe ngalinye, isigcwalisi kanye nephaneli yokuphela kube yimpahla emodelini (IfcFurniture; IfcFurnishingElement ku-IFC2X3) nekhawunta ibe yinto yesakhiwo proxy, imi esitezini igumbi elivela kulo, ngayinye inesolidi lephrizimu eyodwa ngephaneli, nesethi yezakhiwo ye-CabinetCraft (inombolo, isifanekiso, umugqa, usayizi, ukuphakama, izinto, umsebenzi). Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa. Ukubeka futhi kushintsha izakhi zalo msebenzi.
bim.place.label: beka amakhabethe
bim.place.assumed: Igumbi alithathwanga emodelini, ngakho zimi esitezini sokuqala ekuqaleni kwalo.
bim.remove.label: susa amakhabethe
bim.model.title: Uhlu lwemodeli
bim.model.note: Ifunda uhlu emuva kwezakhi emodelini, ngakho luveza lokho okukhona ngempela. Uhlu lokusika lwalo msebenzi (Export ngenhla); ikhabethe ngalinye lithwele inombolo yalo ukuze amabili afanane.
bim.model.nosite: Thatha igumbi emodelini kuqala (ithebhu le-Room) ukuze umsebenzi wazi isitezi sawo.
bim.check.ok: Imodeli inazo zonke izakhi {n} zomsebenzi futhi ayinanto eyengeziwe.
bim.check.diff: Imodeli nomsebenzi ayefani: {missing} ezingekho, {extra} ezengeziwe ({list}). Beka futhi ukuze imodeli ibe yisimo samanje.
bim.draft.title: Uhlelo esitezini lokubonakala kohlelo
bim.draft.note: Udweba uhlelo lomsebenzi (umugqa wegumbi, amakhabethe, amakhawunta, izivulo, amawindi) njengemigqa yokudweba esitezini lohlelo, ukuze ivele ohlelweni nasemashidini. Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa; ukudweba futhi kushintsha lokho. Izinhlangothi nezigaba zamakhabethe ziwumsebenzi we-BimCraft, zisikwe ezakhini; isethi yomsebenzi ingalondolozwa ngenhla njengesethi yamashidi aphrintekayo.
bim.draft.label: udweba lohlelo
